headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 16, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox edged the Detroit Tigers 4-3 in a thrilling victory, with Jordan Hicks earning the win in relief. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture, while Vladimir Guerrero Jr. is on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. Abner Uribe, Colt Emerson, Davis Martin, and Garrett Whitlock are also out with various injuries.

The Milwaukee Brewers bolstered their infield with the acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas in a trade with the Athletics for cash.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox took down the Detroit Tigers 4-3, with Jordan Hicks earning the win in relief. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: Cardinals Take Down Cubs 8-4
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Joshua Báez led the Cardinals' offense with a 3-hit, 3-home run game, driving in 5 runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees suffered a 4-1 loss to the Toronto Blue Jays, with the Blue Jays taking the win. Charles McAdoo led the Yankees at the plate with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Fall to Giants in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Colorado Rockies, winning 7-1 behind a strong performance from Logan Webb. Webb pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Rivero Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels catcher Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture. This move is effective as of August 15, 2026.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have added shortstop Jonathan Ornelas to their roster, acquired in a trade with the Athletics for cash.
